subject: Speculative enquiry: graduate civil engineer or civil drafter, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

This is a speculative enquiry, not a reply to an advertised vacancy. Your careers page invites expressions of interest from graduates and drafting disciplines, including Civil Engineer and Civil Drafter, so I wanted to introduce myself.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge. I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, a licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for site, regional and FIFO work.

Your mix of civil design, drafting, construction monitoring and site inspections across the Riverina is the kind of consultancy work I want to learn. My drafting so far is from study rather than a paid Australian role.

Would you keep me in mind for a graduate civil engineering or civil drafting opening, now or later? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com

letter.subject: Speculative enquiry: graduate civil engineer or civil drafter
paragraphs: I would like to ask whether Xeros Piccolo Consulting Engineers has room for a graduate civil engineer or civil drafter. This is a speculative enquiry rather than a reply to an advertised junior civil role, sent through your careers Expressions of Interest form because it welcomes graduates and drafting disciplines.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at the Albright Institute of Business and Language. I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage, and prepared and reviewed drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards. I also lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries and designed around existing services and site constraints. I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from Divine Word College of Legazpi.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers each day, reviewed drawings and carried out site inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring. As a field engineer on subdivision finishing works I prepared site reports, material records and progress reports and worked with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers.

Your published work across civil and structural design, drafting, construction monitoring and site inspections for residential, commercial and industrial projects in the Riverina is the consultancy mix I want to build toward. I live in Melton VIC and hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and my own transport, with full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am open to discussing relocation for the right regional role. My drafting experience is from study rather than a paid Australian design office.
I have attached my resume. Thank you for considering my enquiry.

checklist: Open https://www.xerospiccolo.com.au/careers/ and use the Expressions of Interest form.
Select Civil Engineer or Civil Drafter as role of interest, Graduate experience, and General Expression of Interest if no matching vacancy.
Upload the resume and this cover letter from the record's attachments.
If there is a message box, paste the short speculative message on this record.
Do not email wagga@ or griffith@ with the same pack; those are office contacts not stated as application inboxes. After submitting, press Applied on this record with the date.
